projects.name: Windhawk Mods
projects.summary: Windhawk mods for Windows 11. Tech Stack Launcher puts a button on the taskbar that starts and stops a configurable working set of apps, folders, editors, URLs and terminal commands.

showcase.problem: A development session can mean opening the same mix of applications, workspaces, folders, URLs and terminal commands, then finding and closing them all again in the right order.
showcase.approach: Tech Stack Launcher adds a native taskbar panel with persistent selections, named profiles, grouped items, launch delays and wait-for-exit behavior. It closes the same selection in reverse order and avoids fragile Windows symbol resolution by using a layered child window.
showcase.outcome: One taskbar action can start or stop a repeatable working environment while optional tools stay disabled until they are needed, and the integration remains resilient across Windows updates.

contributions.summary: Designed and implemented the Win32 taskbar integration, configuration model, process orchestration, profiles, persisted selections and user-facing launcher panel.
